Companion Animal Travel Desk Operations: Booking to Arrival Coordination
This page helps new staff run companion animal travel smoothly and consistently from the first contact through arrival pickup. For Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports traveling pets with clear coordination, accurate documentation, and respectful communication across the cabin team and customer-facing staff. When timelines and required steps are handled correctly, we reduce risk for Millie-like pets and also protect passenger confidence.

Start by confirming the traveler intent, the pet species, and any special handling notes mentioned at intake. Capture preferences and constraints in the shared case record immediately, using calm language that matches the passenger tone. If Yara Khan or Sana Moretti is the traveler, address them directly and keep responses concise, so they know we are actively steering the process. Do not delay coordination while waiting for additional statements; instead, note what is missing and move forward with what is verified.

Next, initiate the booking workflow with the system entry standards required by the desk. <<FACT F091>>. Treat this step as operationally critical; it drives downstream seat and hold planning and supports consistent communication with the cabin team that will monitor the animal during flight.

After booking confirmation, prepare the arrival handoff. Validate that the traveler can be reached close to arrival and that the case record reflects any pickup constraints. <<FACT F089>>. Once that form requirement is captured, align with ground contacts so the pickup staff receive the same expectations and the traveler is not asked to repeat details at the gate.

Throughout the journey window, provide status updates when the passenger asks, but also pro-actively inform them about key checkpoints using neutral, matter-of-fact phrasing. If an issue arises, escalate early to the senior coordinator and document actions taken, including who was informed and what was agreed.

Remember to keep records current and communicate with steady clarity.
